svg.title: buildPQCChain() certificate chain validator control flow
svg.desc: Single combined flowchart of buildPQCChain() in msp/pqc.go. The outer chain-walking loop and the per-link verifyChainLink validation are merged into one top-to-bottom flow. Each iteration tests the depth limit, the self-signed root terminator, performs findIssuerFor, runs the ordered structural checks (validity period, IsCA, conditional keyCertSign, conditional AKID/SKID match), executes dual-key algorithm dispatch keyed on the child signatureAlgorithm OID and issuer SubjectPublicKeyInfo OID, dispatches to either x509.CheckSignatureFrom for classical links or pqclib.Verify for post-quantum links, and falls back to SHA-256 pre-hash for legacy post-quantum credentials before looping to the next link.
svg.text: Control flow of buildPQCChain() in msp/pqc.go
main flow down the centre · error termini on the right · loop-back on the left
match RawIssuer against intermediates then roots
legacy fallback: if algo == "" and issuerAlgo ≠ "", algo ← issuerAlgo
CIRCL for ML-DSA · go-fn-dsa for FN-DSA · no caller-side pre-hash
